Overview

This listing features a cutting-edge directional-freeze brine separator, meticulously engineered for optimal performance and reliability. With a robust throughput of 523 litres per hour, it stands out as a leader in its class, ensuring efficient and consistent processing for demanding operations.

Performance Specifications

Operating at an optimal temperature of 60°C, this separator is ideally suited for applications requiring precise thermal control. It is designed to handle a feed salinity of 4 parts per thousand, making it highly adaptable to a variety of brine compositions. The unit is electrically driven, guaranteeing energy-efficient operation and compatibility with modern industrial standards.

The separator boasts an impressive media service life of 1,463 hours, underscoring its durability and low maintenance requirements. Pricing is determined upon acceptance, providing flexibility to meet unique project demands.

Conclusion
